{"metadata":{"description":"Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): durable JSON-file memory store with memory_save / memory_recall / memory_forget / memory_list model tools, installable as a dsh bundle.","id":"gh:1333710627","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mem","slug":"Jelee0145/dsh-mem","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): durable JSON-file memory store with memor"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"y_save / memory_recall / memory_forget / memory_list model tools, installable as a dsh bundle."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mem — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An out-of-tree **bundle** plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that implements a complete **capability "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"seam** — Service Definition + Service Provider + Consumer. It gives agents durable long-term memory "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"shared across every session: the `memory_save` / `memory_recall` / `memory_forget` / `memory_list` t"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ools persist facts, preferences, and decisions to `$DSH_HOME/memory/memory.json`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Install from the **npm registry** (published as `dsh-mem`):"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> `dsh plugin add` is the dsh way to install a plugin: it resolves the package from npm (via pnpm) i"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nto the profile and registers its bundle layer. Do **not** use `npm install dsh-mem` — that installs"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" the package as a plain dependency without activating any profile layer."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"From git instead (runs the package's self-contained `prepare` build; the first install asks you to a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"llow the build in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Or from a local checkout:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Verify the composed layer without booting, then boot:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile demo remove dsh-mem`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"To disable without uninstalling (hot-reloaded, no restart), disable the rows in the profile's own `c"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"t uninstalling (hot-reloaded, no restart), disable the rows in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Memory data is never touched by uninstall; it lives in `$DSH_HOME/memory/memory.json` (default `~/.d"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"sh/memory/`). Back it up or delete it separately if you want to clear it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## The capability seam"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Role | Module | Mounted row | Notes |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Service Definition | `src/memory.ts` (`dsh-mem/memory`) | — | abstract `MemoryService` declaring t"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"he `ctx.memory` contract and types; loading it directly fails loud |
| Service Provider | `src/provi"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"der.ts` (`dsh-mem/provider`) | `memory` | `MemoryFile extends MemoryService`; atomic JSON-file persi"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"stence |
| Consumer | `src/tool.ts` (`dsh-mem/tool`) | `tool-memory` | function plugin registering t"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"he four tools; resolves the service via `ctx.get('memory')` per call |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"This mirrors the in-repo `ctx.jobs` seam (Definition in `packages/jobs/jobs`, provider in `jobs-loca"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"l`, consumer in `tool-jobs`)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Repository layout"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Build"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Working beside a dsh checkout, `dsh-memory/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` can be junctioned to the rep"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"o packages so local typechecking works without `npm install`:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Smoke tests (build first):"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Memory entries and storage"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Each note is an immutable record of 5–6 fields:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Field | Source | Meaning |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `id` | provider | `m-<n>`; keeps counting across restarts |
| `content` | model | the durable fact"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" as a complete standalone sentence or short paragraph |
| `tags` | model | keywords for filtering; e"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"mpty strings are dropped |
| `project` | model | the owning project/workspace (e.g. repository name)"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"; absent means a global fact that applies everywhere |
| `createdAt` / `updatedAt` | provider, stamp"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ed automatically | epoch milliseconds; the model never supplies the timestamp, and the tool output i"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ncludes a human-readable `createdAtText` (ISO 8601) |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Stored at `$DSH_HOME/memory/memory.json` (default `~/.dsh/memory/`), e.g.:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Design notes"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **Why the provider owns a JSON file instead of the `ctx.storage` seam**: dsh's storage rows (`stor"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"age` / `storage-json` / `storage-domain`) are mounted by the `dsh-web-app` bundle, not by `dsh-base`"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"; an out-of-tree bundle that inserts the same row ids would duplicate them in web profiles, while om"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"itting them leaves `ctx.storage` absent in headless ones. One self-managed JSON document keeps this "},{"id":"p38s5","text":"plugin zero-dependency on every profile (web / headless / custom). To swap in a `ctx.storage.domain`"},{"id":"p38s6","text":" backend, subclass `MemoryService` and point the `memory` row at it — the tools and contract stay un"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"touched. That is the point of the seam.
- **Durability**: every mutation writes memory first, then c"},{"id":"p38s8","text":"ommits via `writeFileAtomic` (temp file + atomic rename, `0o600`/`0o700`); nothing is visible before"},{"id":"p38s9","text":" it is durable. All operations (reads included) serialize on one in-process queue, so a read never o"},{"id":"p38s10","text":"bserves an uncommitted write. Concurrent dsh processes sharing one `root` are not supported.
- **Doc"},{"id":"p38s11","text":"ument format**: `{ version, nextId, entries }`; `nextId` is persisted so ids stay unique across rest"},{"id":"p38s12","text":"arts. A wrong version or a corrupt file fails loud at load — never a silent reset.
- **Model tool co"},{"id":"p38s13","text":"ntract**: search is a case-insensitive substring match on content plus exact tag match; an empty que"},{"id":"p38s14","text":"ry returns the newest notes. `recall`/`list` accept a `project` filter (case-insensitive exact; glob"},{"id":"p38s15","text":"al notes never match). Result caps are clamped to the deployment's `maxRecallLimit`. Oversized conte"},{"id":"p38s16","text":"nt, illegal limits, and malformed ids are rejected at the tool boundary. When to save and what to sa"},{"id":"p38s17","text":"ve is guided by the tool descriptions: project-specific facts must carry `project`; global facts (e."},{"id":"p38s18","text":"g. user preferences) omit it; timestamps are provider-stamped and cannot be forged by the model.
- *"},{"id":"p38s19","text":"*Dependencies**: `@deepseek-ai/cordis@^4.0.1` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*@^0.1.0-rc.6` are published on "},{"id":"p38s20","text":"npm; `dsh plugin add` installs them into the profile."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Extending"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- **Swap the provider**: subclass `MemoryService`, then point the `memory` row's `name` at your clas"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"s in `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **Add a human command**: inject `ctx.commands` (present in base) and regi"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"ster a `/memory`-style slash command.
- **Inject memory into a turn**: in an `agent/pre-step` or `to"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"ols/post-execute` listener, call `agent.inject()` with relevant notes for the next request.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"- Single-process writer: no cross-process lock when two dsh processes share one `root`.
- No edit AP"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"I: `updatedAt` equals `createdAt` today; to overwrite a fact, `memory_forget` then `memory_save`.
- "},{"id":"p42s3","text":"No structured schema: content is free text; for fielded facts, agree on a fixed text format with the"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"ctured schema: content is free text; for fielded facts, agree on a fixed text format with the model."}],"truncated":true}
